crossrefs.text: The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”
But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

notes.title: Humanity in God's image, and Christ the image of God

groups.title: The royal line: Judah to David to Jesus

crossrefs.text: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
He acted with all his heart in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law and the commandments, in order to seek his God. And so he prospered.
Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
For it is Godʼs will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
